evidence.title: lucide-animated | Free Animated React Icons Library

name: lucide-animated
summary: Open-source set of 467+ animated Lucide icons for React, powered by Motion and installable with the shadcn CLI.
description: A free icon library that rebuilds Lucide icons as animated React components: every icon animates on hover, forwards standard SVG props and gets a page with copy-ready install commands, keywords and similar icons. Icons install one at a time with the shadcn CLI (@lucide-animated/<name>); MIT licensed, with Svelte, Vue, Angular and Flutter ports, an agent skill, llms.txt documentation and an MCP server at /mcp.
contains: based on Lucide, built with Motion
install with the shadcn CLI: pnpm dlx shadcn add @lucide-animated/<icon>
MIT licensed, free for personal and commercial use
Svelte, Vue, Angular and Flutter community ports
MCP server with searchicons, listicons and geticon tools
per-icon markdown, llms-full.txt and an agent skill
